attr.title: Crystalien Conflict
attr.desc: A Crystalien Conflict Remake made in the Godot game engine. (Crystalien Conflict was a cult classic flash game made by the Lego group to promote the "Mars Misson" toyline, with gameplay similar to Command & Conquer. Special thanks to B1er0l14m sharing the source code and agreeing to let the game be ready-to-run.
attr.inst: Game is ready to run. Use D-pad or left joystick to move camera, use right joystick to move cursor. Use right trigger to select.
